import os
import re
import openpyxl

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/3911/1_3911_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/3911_0_514b9d44/1_3911_output.xlsx"

def to_number(value):
    if value is None:
        return 0
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        return int(round(value))
    text = str(value)
    text = re.sub(r"[^\d.-]", "", text)
    return int(round(float(text))) if text else 0

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["denomination"]

# Denomination columns H:P and salary column E
denom_cols = range(8, 17)  # H:P
denominations = [to_number(ws.cell(row=1, column=col).value) for col in denom_cols]

# Fill exact answer range H2:P8 only
for row in range(2, 9):
    remaining = to_number(ws.cell(row=row, column=5).value)  # NetSalary in column E
    for col, denom in zip(denom_cols, denominations):
        count = remaining // denom if denom else 0
        ws.cell(row=row, column=col).value = count
        remaining -= count * denom

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
